labels.U: the revised plan put in front of placers: a stale plan replaced, one current instruction posted, helpers routed to it, updates made noticeable
labels.G: a planned change undone by the room's own keepers who had not heard of it
labels.F: the plan made findable and usable for helpers: coordinates explained, landmarks, a copy for outsiders, a colour or a corner clarified
labels.W: the plan follows the work: the reference corrected against placements, recovered from work under way, or ratified after building
labels.K: the reference kept: recovered, restored, replaced after loss, or handed over
labels.E: an error in the reference itself corrected or contested
labels.T: tools to make or follow the plan (a generator, a converter, an overlay script, a drawing program)
labels.O: a plan kept open: revisions shown, adoption provisional
